steps.en: Mobile number is available before sending
steps.id: Nomor mobile sudah ada sebelum SMS dikirim
steps.why_en: The number comes from stored data; the live lookup is switched off.
steps.why_id: Nomor berasal dari data tersimpan; pencarian langsung dimatikan.

steps.en: Batch job picks AN notices ready to notify
steps.id: Job batch memilih notice AN yang siap diberi tahu
steps.why_en: Some vehicle types and already-suspended ANs are skipped, and the schedule is switched off.
steps.why_id: Beberapa tipe kendaraan dan AN yang sudah ditangguhkan dilewati, dan jadwalnya dimatikan.

steps.en: Individual owners are routed to SMS
Each unique owner gets one SMS per batch
steps.id: Tiap owner unik hanya dapat satu SMS per batch
steps.why_en: The system sends one SMS per notice, so an owner with three notices gets three.
steps.why_id: Sistem mengirim satu SMS per notice, jadi owner dengan tiga notice dapat tiga.

steps.en: SMS text comes from the AN template
steps.id: Isi SMS diambil dari template AN
steps.why_en: The template lives in the database; if it is missing the SMS is silently skipped.
steps.why_id: Template ada di database; kalau tidak ada SMS dilewati tanpa kabar.

steps.en: SMS is sent to each owner in a batch
steps.id: SMS dikirim ke tiap owner dalam satu batch
steps.why_en: The send path exists but the schedule and SMS switch are off in the repo settings.
steps.why_id: Jalur kirim ada, tapi jadwal dan saklar SMS mati di pengaturan repo.

steps.en: Each SMS result is judged per recipient
steps.id: Hasil tiap SMS dinilai per penerima
steps.why_en: One failed SMS makes the whole batch count as not sent.
steps.why_id: Satu SMS gagal membuat seluruh batch dianggap belum terkirim.

steps.en: Send status is saved per notice
